basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Bhopal will hold a walk-in written test and/or interview on 10 November 2026, with reporting at 9:30 AM. The venue is the Office of the Department of General Medicine, UGF, Hospital Building, AIIMS Bhopal, Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020. The walk-in is for 2 posts of Project Technical Assistant (Project Technical Support – III as per ICMR nomenclature) on contract, at Rs 35,000/- per month (consolidated, includes HRA), under Advertisement No. AIIMS/BPL/MED/SK/AMS/2026/01 dated 26 October 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on the date of walk-in (10 November 2026). Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates, retrenched Government employees, departmental candidates (including projects) and ex-servicemen, in accordance with instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time. As per ICMR guidelines, the Head of the Institution may also grant an age relaxation of up to 5 years, on a case-to-case basis, to deserving candidates with experience of working in Government Research Organisations.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is located at Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020, Madhya Pradesh. Its letterhead describes it as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. These posts are for the Department of Health Research (DHR), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India funded multicentric project "Economic Evaluation of Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS) and Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) interventions in Indian Healthcare Facilities – Multicentric Study". The project runs under Principal Investigator Dr. Sagar Khadanga, Additional Professor, Department of General Medicine, AIIMS Bhopal.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhopal has 02 posts of Project Technical Assistant (Project Technical Support – III as per ICMR nomenclature), both shown as UR. The place of posting is AIIMS Bhopal. The essential qualification follows the ICMR guidelines for Project Technical Support – III and is either of the following: Three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years post-qualification experience; OR Post Graduate degree in relevant subject/field. Good understanding of the healthcare delivery system. Research/field work experience in public health projects. Good working knowledge of computer applications, such as MS Word and Excel. Excellent verbal & written communication skills. The essential qualifications are as per the ICMR Guidelines for Non-Institutional Project Human Resource Positions, as amended vide letter No. 16/29/2023/Admn dated 18.10.2024. All educational qualifications and certificates shall be from a recognised Board/University. Experience shall be preferably from Government organisations and is counted after the date of completion of the minimum essential qualification. Experience in the relevant field/area, as required for the project, will be considered. All community certificates shall be issued by the authorised officers of the Government. The prescribed qualifications are the minimum, and meeting them does not guarantee selection. The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on the date of walk-in (10 November 2026). Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC candidates, retrenched Government employees, departmental candidates (including projects) and ex-servicemen, in accordance with instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time. As per ICMR guidelines, the Head of the Institution may also grant an age relaxation of up to 5 years, on a case-to-case basis, to deserving candidates with experience of working in Government Research Organisations. The remuneration of Rs. 35,000/- per month is consolidated, as per the sanction of the funding agency, and includes HRA. No other allowances are paid. Paid leave is 1.5 days per completed month of engagement, as per ICMR guidelines. The tenure is 8 months. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project (up to 20/05/2027), subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of funding. Any extension depends on the funding agency extending the project. The appointment gives no claim to a regular post at AIIMS Bhopal or at the funding agency (DHR/MoHFW). The Principal Investigator may extend or end the employment. The contract ends automatically at the end of the specified period unless it is renewed, and either party can end it with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof. faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Assistant walk-in?
faq.answer: The walk-in written test and/or interview is on 10 November 2026, and the reporting time is 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the AIIMS Bhopal walk-in venue?
faq.answer: The venue is the Office of the Department of General Medicine, UGF, Hospital Building, AIIMS Bhopal, Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of Project Technical Assistant (Project Technical Support – III as per ICMR nomenclature), shown as UR in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The qualification is a three years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three years post-qualification experience, OR a Post Graduate degree in relevant subject/field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on the date of walk-in. Relaxation applies to SC/ST/OBC candidates, retrenched Government employees, departmental candidates (including projects) and ex-servicemen, as per Central Government instructions. The Head of the Institution may grant up to 5 years to candidates with experience in Government Research Organisations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs 35,000/- per month, consolidated, as per the sanction of the funding agency.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA or any allowance paid on top of the Rs 35,000 pay?
faq.answer: No. The Rs 35,000/- per month is consolidated and already includes HRA, and no other allowances are paid.

faq.question: Q8. Will there be a written test at the AIIMS Bhopal walk-in?
faq.answer: A written test of 50 MCQs will be held only if more than 30 eligible candidates report. To qualify, candidates need 40% (UR/OBC/EWS) or 35% (SC/ST). Otherwise, selection is based only on the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a contractual post for 8 months and is co-terminus with the project (up to 20/05/2027). It gives no claim to a regular post at AIIMS Bhopal or DHR/MoHFW.

faq.question: Q10. Is there an application fee for the AIIMS Bhopal walk-in?
faq.answer: No. The application fee is Nil, and no application needs to be sent in advance.
